messages:
Mina (Marketing): Hey team—Greenhaven agreed to a short case study tied to last week's benchmark. Need: signed quote release, 30min recorded interview, legal OK on publishing graphs, and an inbound-leads form. Target: launch + webinar in ~3 weeks.
Jared (Content): I'll draft a two-line blurb and a tweet. Who's PR? Lana?
Lana (AE): PR is Maya Chen (maya@greenhaven.ai). I'll intro today. For leads, prefer HubSpot hidden form tagged greenhaven-bench routed to AE queue.
Omar (Legal): We'll need a signed Customer Release for quotes and any performance numbers. Non-numeric phrasing is fine for now; explicit numbers require opt-in on the form.
Ivy (CS): I'll export the charts and include a short methodology note. One run had a transient CPU spike—I'll annotate.
room-bot: Recording room reserved: "Case-Greenhaven-Spotlight" at 1750120000 (link: https://meet.redwood/rooms/case-greenhaven).
Jared (Content): Draft quote: "Redwood helped us reduce inference latency and ship features faster." I'll make 1-line and 2-line versions.
Mina (Marketing): Good. Jared, produce web and social variants. Omar, can you pre-approve non-numeric language so Lana can get Maya's sign-off quickly?
Omar (Legal): Pre-approve non-numeric copy. If Greenhaven wants numbers public, we need explicit written opt-in on the release.
Lana (AE): I'll send the release to Maya today and confirm speaker availability for the recording slot.
Ivy (CS): Charts and CSVs sent to Jared. Includes test notes and the annotated outlier.
Jared (Content): Got assets—I'll share the draft by tomorrow morning.
Mina (Marketing): Plan: Lana gets release signed, Omar reviews signed PDF in #legal-approvals, Ivy finalizes assets, Jared drafts copy; embargo until webinar. Daily quick check-ins. :thumbsup:
